calculation: Corrected AFH-default Xe-131 response substitution in four fixed-speed benchmarks
AFH_source: DMFormFactor v6.0 built-in sdgXe131; 67 density-matrix entries

normalization.note: The factor four follows from the v6.0 code convention c1^0=c1^p+c1^n, so gp=gn=gVN corresponds to c1^0=2*gVN.

three_body_kernel.scope: Controlled nuclear-response substitution; the archived Eq.(6) I6 grid and particle/propagator prefactors are held fixed.

particle_inputs.width: Conditional pole width from prior calculation; Dirac fermion + real scalar + pure scalar off-diagonal Yukawa; not a full self-energy width.

limitations: Fixed mono-speed v=800 km/s; no halo velocity integration.
The existing I6 grid is reused; this is not a fresh independent 640-point Eq.(6) integral.
No detector efficiency, resolution, cuts, or likelihood.
The conditional width is not a full self-energy calculation.
Native Mathematica execution of AFH v6.0 remains pending.
